title: The Royal Infant (U Khunlung Syiem)
cultural_context: Royal matriarchal lullaby dedicated to the newborn prince of the Syiem lineage, invoking guardian spirits, from 'Ki Khasi Poems'.

khasi: Ha pneh ba syaid jong ka kmie;
Ki blei lum ki da ia me,
Na man ka jingsniew ba wan;
Me long ka jingkyrmen ka hima,
Ka khet ba kyntang ka ap;
Haba me san ban long u rangbah,
Me dei ban kamai ia ka hok.
english: Sleep peacefully, O royal infant child,
In the warm tender embrace of your mother;
The guardian spirits of the peaks watch over you,
Shielding you from every approaching harm;
You are the rising hope of our principality,
The sacred council stool awaits you;
You must rule by righteousness alone.

khasi: Ban pynthiah ia la i khun;
Ka paila mukmor bad ka ksiar
Ki thaba ha pneh jong me;
Ia ki khun ki hajar ka ri;
Ba me long u kpa ban sumar,
Ha ka hok bad ka jingshisha.
english: Lulling the darling infant to sleep;
The coral beads and royal gold
O child, remember throughout your life,
The humble subjects of the realm;
You are called to be a protective father,

vocabulary.khunlung syiem: royal infant / child of the kingly clan
